entities.name: Skarrg
entities.description: A ruined gathering place deep in the Rubblebelt of Ravnica, the closest thing the Gruul Clans have to a guildhall.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A devastated section of the Red Wastes on Ravnica, home to the Gruul.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Skarrg is located.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A guild of wild clans who gather at Skarrg.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which the Gruul regrouped at Skarrg.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: The new guildleader of the Gruul, killed by the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: The invading army that killed Domri Rade.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: A Gruul leader who wanted the Gruul to act independently of the other guilds.

entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: A Gruul leader who wanted the Gruul to cooperate with other guilds against the invaders.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Gan's daughter who convinced Borborygmos to let go of his grudges.

events.summary: After Domri Rade's death at the hands of the Dreadhorde, the Gruul Clans regroup at Skarrg.
events.quote: the death of their new guildleader Domri Rade at the hands of the invading Dreadhorde

events.summary: Borborygmos and Gan Shokta come to a showdown at Skarrg over whether the Gruul should act alone or cooperate with other guilds, and break into a fight.
events.quote: The two broke into a fight

events.summary: Araithia Shokta intervenes and convinces Borborygmos to let go of his grudges, allowing the Gruul to band together with the plane's defenders.
events.quote: Gan's daughter Araithia Shokta intervened and convinced Borborygmos to let go of his grudges against the other guilds
